name: C Worth Superstore
old_description: Our team at C Worth Superstore is proud to be your go-to restaurant supply store in Lexington, KY. As your one-stop shop for all of your commercial kitchen and culinary needs, we know that it takes a lot to get your food service up and running. As one of Kentucky's largest restaurant equipment suppliers, we're prepared to meet your needs. We specialize in professional kitchen supplies, commercial refrigerators, catering supplies, commercial cooking equipment, and more. Our kitchen designers will ensure that your operation functions efficiently, and our installation team will coordinate the delivery of your equipment and supplies. Stop in or contact us today to see why we've been in business since 1954!
about:
C Worth Superstore has operated as a restaurant supply store in Lexington, Kentucky, since 1954. The company serves as a one-stop shop for commercial kitchen and culinary needs across the state.

The business supplies a broad range of commercial kitchen equipment, including restaurant and bar supplies, catering equipment, commercial cooking equipment, commercial refrigeration and dishwashers, food preparation equipment, ice machines, smallwares, janitorial supplies, cutlery, and restaurant furniture. It also provides commercial kitchen design, delivery, installation, and lease-to-own financing options.

Customers include restaurants, bars, catering operations, and other food service establishments throughout Kentucky. The company carries equipment from brands such as Hobart, Vulcan, Manitowoc, Vollrath, and hundreds of other manufacturers.

C Worth Superstore distinguishes itself as one of Kentucky's largest restaurant equipment suppliers, with kitchen designers who ensure efficient operation layouts and an installation team that coordinates delivery. The company also offers both new and reconditioned equipment and lease-to-own arrangements.
